scope: Source-stated design commitments in these three reports only; not implementation evidence, independent empirical confirmation, or nine-report consensus.

feature_definitions.O: fixed mathematical objects with certified representations/observations
feature_definitions.G: scoped guards and composition without silently strengthening meaning
feature_definitions.V: verified algorithm/checker distinguished from actual trusted execution and reification
feature_definitions.D: ordinary theorem/definition packages with separate operational policy
feature_definitions.L: provider exact target, displayed edit replay, honest negative outcomes
feature_definitions.E: equally equipped Lean baselines, negative neighbors, measurable stopping criteria

rows.note: Claims, transformations and constructions fix different result specifications; local equality, jets and enclosures are not global equality.
